request.summary: Stop false-positive fire cape/infernal cape/Dizana's quiver accomplishment alerts by gating them on a Collection Log new-item message, and make the mega-rare drop allowlist match the uncharged item IDs that Tumeken's shadow (and Scythe of vitur) actually drop as.
request.raw_requirements:
So a few issues:

* False positives
   * Fire cape, infernal cape, etc are posting for those where it isnt a Collection Log in some cases for Accomplishments. These should ONLY post when they are received as collection logs as well. 
* Tumekens Shadow did not post as a drop within Accomplishments, someone received one recently and it posted to loot-sharing instead. Alternatively, Twisted Bow is working as expected

plan.approach: Gate OneTimeRewardListener on the game's Collection Log new-item chat message (wording verified from RuneLite's ScreenshotPlugin) instead of loose completion-text matching plus plugin-side one-time flags, and add the uncharged Scythe of vitur / Tumeken's shadow item IDs to LootAlertListener's accomplishment allowlist, since raids drop the uncharged items.
steps: LootAlertListener.java: add SCYTHE_OF_VITUR_UNCHARGED and TUMEKENS_SHADOW_UNCHARGED to TRACKED_ACCOMPLISHMENT_ITEM_IDS (keep charged IDs).

OneTimeRewardListener.java: rewrite around the 'New item added to your collection log: <item>' message with a Reward enum + package-private static match(); drop topic/verb patterns, one-time flags and ConfigManager dependency; keep GAMEMESSAGE filter.
Add OneTimeRewardListenerTest (JUnit 4) pinning matches and non-matches.
Log decisions in worklog (flags removed, uncharged-ID root cause incl. Scythe, in-game notification setting dependency, first automated test).

verification.notes: Passed on automated evidence: no open blockers; ./gradlew compileJava test BUILD SUCCESSFUL; OneTimeRewardListenerTest 4/4 pass (verified from the XML report, not just the exit code); diff limited to the two planned source files plus the new test. Collection-log wording and the uncharged item IDs were verified against the pinned RuneLite jars, not recalled. Functional UAT (a real new collection log entry for fire cape/infernal cape/Dizana's quiver, a real Tumeken's shadow or Scythe drop posting as an accomplishment) cannot be triggered in dev and is deferred to post-ship live testing, as the developer previously established for this project. The developer has not explicitly confirmed the DoD items for this task.
